title: Giraffe waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#f2a93b'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='66' r='4' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='5' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='80' r='4' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='3' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#d98d2b'/>
  <rect x='38' y='84' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f2a93b'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#d98d2b'/>
  <rect x='63' y='84' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f2a93b'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 66 Q66 48 60 32 L70 30 Q78 50 72 68 Z' fill='#f2a93b'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='3' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='3' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='27' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f2a93b'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='30' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffd89b'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='60' y1='20' x2='58' y2='13' stroke='#d98d2b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='19' x2='68' y2='12' stroke='#d98d2b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='22' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f2a93b' transform='rotate(-30 57 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='20' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f2a93b' transform='rotate(20 72 20)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='25' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M70 32 Q74 35 78 32' stroke='#a8641a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='29' r='1' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 68 Q14 66 13 60' stroke='#d98d2b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='58' r='3' fill='#a8641a'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M58 64 Q70 60 76 50' stroke='#f2a93b' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hoof/hand -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='48' r='4' fill='#d98d2b'/>
  <!-- waving motion lines -->
  <path d='M84 44 Q88 40 86 35' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 48 Q92 45 91 40' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
